title: On a Telegraph Process with Generalized Mittag-Leffler Waiting times and Velocity Driven by Random trials
summary: We study a generalized telegraph process in which the velocity is governed by random trials by considering the specific distribution of waiting times. In this telegraph process, a particle moving on real line may change its direction whenever there is an arrival in a counting process. This direction change is driven by the outcomes of random trials. In the first case, random trials are independent and identically distributed, and waiting times have Mittag-Leffler distribution.
